matchup.plan_md:
**Where things stand:**
- **Matchup 5 final:** Snow Time Lakers **1,627**, Come-in Cider **1,546**.
- **Roster moves recorded (ESPN sync):** Saddiq Bey dropped, Kevin Huerter added (23 Nov).
- **Adds:** 0 used this matchup of 6, so **6 left**. Thu 26 Nov has no games.
- **With no moves:** **1,495 to 1,396** in our favour.
- **Pending trade** with Dr White Slong: Black, Murphy and Leonard for Donovan Mitchell and Derrick White. It expires 25 Nov 04:05 UTC. Per the standing rule, it does not hold up any move below.

**Research that shapes the plan** (news watch, 23 Nov):
- **Kevin Huerter** is 1-of-8 from his last start, and his start ends when Duncan Robinson returns (re-evaluation about 24 Nov; *ESPN est.* 27 Nov). L7 16.5 (4).
- **Yves Missi** is a backup center behind Zion Williamson and Derik Queen's minutes. Rate 24.4.
- **Waiver claims** (Norman Powell, Zach LaVine, Bey) clear at 7:00 PM Melbourne today and are worth less than free agents here:
  - Powell is out most of the week (hamstring; *ESPN est.* 28 Nov).
  - LaVine's whole week is worth +19.
  - Bey's whole week is worth +26, back to the bench.
- **Dean Wade** tops the script's chains, but his L7 39.5 rests on two spot starts (small sample). LeBron James and Joel Embiid are back, so expect 18–23 bench minutes. His rate overstates him.
- **Jaxson Hayes** is out (left knee), and his role row is removed.

**The plans scored** (`council/matchup.py --next`; they score 1,396):

| Plan | **Mon 23** · adds by **Tue 11:00 AM** | **Tue 24** · by **Wed 11:00 AM** | **Wed 25** · by **Thu 9:00 AM** | **Fri 27** · by **Sat 11:00 AM** | **Sat 28** · by **Sun 9:00 AM** | **Sun 29** · by **Mon 7:30 AM** | Lineup | Final |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---:|---|
| **Lopez + Goodwin (the plan)** | Missi → Brook Lopez; Huerter → Jordan Goodwin | — | — | — | — | — | **1,575** | **about 1,575 to 1,396** |
| Lopez only | Missi → Brook Lopez | — | — | — | — | — | 1,550 | about 1,550 to 1,396 |
| Lopez + Wade (script's pick) | Missi → Brook Lopez | — | Huerter → Dean Wade | — | — | — | 1,605 | about 1,605 to 1,396 |
| Lopez + 3-add chain | Missi → Lopez; Huerter → Grimes | Grimes → Queta | Queta → Wade | — | — | — | 1,642 | about 1,642 to 1,396 |
| No moves | — | — | — | — | — | — | 1,495 | 1,495 to 1,396 |

**Verdict:**
- **Lopez and Goodwin, both on Monday.**
  - **Lopez** (LAC) plays 4 games (Mon, Wed, Fri, Sun) and is the best single hold: +55 for the week over Missi.
  - **Goodwin** (PHX) also plays 4. He is a steady 24 min, not a role that ends this week.
- **Together they are worth +80** for 2 of the 6 adds. That leaves 4 adds for the thin days later in the week: Wed 25 (3 of ours play) and Sat 28 (3 play). Re-run on Wednesday to pick those streams.
- **Not the Wade or Queta chains.** Their extra 30–67 points rest on roles that are ending: Wade's spot starts, and Queta's minutes while Mitchell Robinson is ill.
- **Plan line:** 2 adds.

**Steps, Melbourne time:**
1. **Before 11:00 AM Tue 24** (Monday's first tip-off, 7:00 PM ET):
   - drop **Yves Missi**, add **Brook Lopez** (LAC @ HOU Monday);
   - drop **Kevin Huerter**, add **Jordan Goodwin** (PHX @ NO Monday).
   - Neither dropped player has a game before then.
2. **No waiver claims** needed today.
3. **Wednesday:** re-run the matchup for the Fri–Sun streams with the 4 adds left.

**Form:**

| Brook Lopez | 33.3 | 31.3 (15) | 36.5 (4) | 35.4 (7) | 30.6 (14) | 26.2 |
| Jordan Goodwin | 27.7 | 26.6 (11) | 27.8 (4) | 28.5 (6) | 28.0 (10) | — |
| Dean Wade | 28.1 | 21.5 (13) | 39.5 (2), small sample | 24.6 (5) | 21.5 (13) | 16.3 |
| Yves Missi | 24.4 | 29.1 (7) | 24.0 (4) | 24.2 (5) | 22.7 (6) | 24.7 |
| Kevin Huerter | 29.1 ‡ (rate 22.2) | 22.3 (16) | 16.5 (4) | 28.4 (8) | 23.2 (15) | 22.9 |

**Why the L7s are 5+ off the season:**
- **Lopez, +5.2:** slightly more minutes (26.0 against 24.6); no other reason found.
- **Wade, +18.0:** two spot starts, a small sample.
- **Missi, −5.1:** same minutes, lower output; no other reason found.
- **Huerter, −5.8:** shooting, 14-of-41 over 30–36 minute starts.

news-watch.changed_md:
- **Our players:**
  - **Jalen Duren:** still out; the two-week re-evaluation has passed with no result reported. Tue 24 at ORL is the earliest game; *ESPN est.* 24 Nov. The return row stays at 24 Nov.
  - **Kevin Huerter** shot 1-of-8 on Sunday, and his starting role ends when Duncan Robinson returns (re-evaluation about 24 Nov; *ESPN est.* 27 Nov). His L7 is 16.5 (4).
  - **Daniss Jenkins** started again (38 min). His role ends with Duren's return.
  - **Jalen Smith** played Sunday, started at center and scored a career-high 26 in 34 min. Rotoworld has him keeping the start when Nic Claxton is back. The rest flag was a misread.
  - **Trey Murphy III** is probable for Mon 23 vs PHX. Sun 29 at POR is the first night of a back-to-back, so it is safe.
  - **Paul George** sat Sunday for rest, not injury (official report: "Out – Rest"). He is due back Tue 24 (*ESPN est.* 24 Nov).
  - **Cade Cunningham** played through his knee soreness: 33 min, 31 FP. **Anthony Black** started at WAS, 35 min.
- **Pickup targets:**
  - **Norman Powell** (waivers) has a mild hamstring strain and will likely miss Mon 23 and Wed 25 (*ESPN est.* 28 Nov). Claiming him is no longer worth it this week.
  - **Saddiq Bey** (waivers, our drop) is likely back to the bench at about 25 min with Murphy starting.
  - **Quentin Grimes** starts Mon 23 with Austin Reaves out (Reaves' next chance is Fri 27; *ESPN est.* 27 Nov).
  - **Jaxson Hayes** left Sunday's game with a left knee injury and is listed out (*ESPN est.* 23 Nov).
  - **Dean Wade:** his big L7 rests on two spot starts, a small sample. LeBron James and Joel Embiid are back, so expect 18–23 min off the bench.
  - **Neemias Queta's** 30-minute games came while Mitchell Robinson was ill (*ESPN est.* 24 Nov).
- **This week's opponent (Matt Wright's Foxies):**
  - **De'Aaron Fox** is questionable Mon with a right shin contusion. No timetable reported; *ESPN est.* 23 Nov.
  - **Pascal Siakam** played Sunday. Mon 23 is the second night of Indiana's back-to-back, a rest risk.
  - **Evan Mobley** is still out (re-evaluation about 23–26 Nov; *ESPN est.* 29 Nov).
  - **Darryn Peterson** has started every game; his minutes dip came from foul trouble and a blowout.
- **Elsewhere:** Victor Wembanyama is questionable Mon with low back tightness (not in ESPN's feed). Karl-Anthony Towns is back from his illness.
- **Overrides:**
  - **Moved:** Scotty Pippen Jr. and Dejounte Murray, both to 30 Nov. Both are out Mon 23 (official report, 22 Nov 11:15 PM ET), and Murray sits until he is traded.
  - **Removed:** the Hayes and Bamba role rows (Hayes is out), and the expired McCollum, Suggs and Proctor rows.
  - **Not added:** a Dyson Daniels role row, because no source gives his minutes.
- **Re-run the matchup:** yes, matchup 6 starts today.
